problem.title: DiLO KITTI Odom seq 09 full (1591 frames): held-out check of the paper pipeline
problem.question: Does the DiLO paper pipeline, with the values chosen on seq 07 (00 held out), stay near the paper's per-sequence KITTI Odometry error (official RTE) on seq 09?

variants.label: DiLO paper pipeline + spread planar key points + slope-aware vertical fill + 0.18 deg correction
variants.intent: Planarity > 0.98 and at most one key point per 8 x 8 px cell per list (the ground list clustered ahead of the car, the side lists on vegetation, so roll was barely constrained), a vertical fill that no longer puts the far ground under the road (fill_slope 0.1), and the 0.18 deg correction that zeroes the pitch bias once the fill is fixed. Chosen on 07 windows, 00 windows held out (see papers/dilo/README.md).
variants.note: DiLO paper odometry (192x2048 sin-elevation range image, top 3 deg, vertical fill up to 4 rows, Farid-filter normals, 11 planarity-weighted key-point lists x 100, window of 10 frames, 5 pairwise-averaging iterations; plane key points only); poses after leaving the window; no GT seed.
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.

variants.label: DiLO paper pipeline, spread planar key points, degenerate translation directions kept at the prediction
variants.intent: As paper_odometry_spread_keypoints, plus solution remapping (not in the paper): translation directions whose eigenvalue in the translation block of the normal equations is below 0.03 of the largest keep the prediction. Chosen on KITTI 01 (open highway, 8.7 -> 1.5 %; 0.02-0.05 all work); 00 and 07 are unchanged.
variants.note: DiLO paper odometry (192x2048 sin-elevation range image, top 3 deg, vertical fill up to 4 rows, Farid-filter normals, degenerate translation directions below 0.030000 of the largest kept at the prediction (not in the paper), 11 planarity-weighted key-point lists x 100, window of 10 frames, 5 pairwise-averaging iterations; plane key points only); poses after leaving the window; no GT seed.
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.
